Initial release of doubao-launch.

- Launches the Doubao desktop application with real-time translation window.
- Supports configurable translation modes: "dual" (default) or "single".
- Returns window handle, title, and operation status as JSON.
- Integrates into YouTube translation workflow alongside audio download, playback, and subtitle capture.
- Includes consistent JSON error handling for workflow compatibility.
- Note: Requires visible Windows desktop environment.
